# UK Payroll Calculators

> UK Payroll Calculators (https://payrollcalc.co.uk) is a free set of UK pay and tax calculators: take-home pay after Income Tax and National Insurance, Statutory Sick Pay, NHS pay, VAT, employer costs, pro-rata salary, payslips, student loan repayments and leave. Every calculator is free to use with no sign-up, and figures use current official UK rates and bands.

## Calculators

- NHS pay calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/nhs-pay-calculator — Take-home pay by Agenda for Change band and point.
- Statutory Sick Pay calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/ssp-calculator
- VAT calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/vat-calculator — Add or remove 20% UK VAT.
- Employer cost calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/employer-cost-calculator — The full cost of an employee, including employer National Insurance.
- Employer National Insurance calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/employer-national-insurance-calculator
- Payslip calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/payslip-calculator
- Pro-rata salary calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/pro-rata-salary-calculator
- Student loan repayment calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/student-loan-repayment-calculator
- Umbrella company calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/umbrella-company-calculator
- Salary sacrifice calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/salary-sacrifice-calculator
- Childcare calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/childcare-calculator — Tax-Free Childcare top-up per child (up to £2,000 a year, £4,000 if disabled), with the £100,000 eligibility check.
- Texas paycheck calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/us/texas-paycheck-calculator — US net pay in Texas under the 2026 IRS rules: federal income tax and FICA, with $0 state income tax.
- Ohio paycheck calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/us/ohio-paycheck-calculator — US net pay in Ohio under the 2026 rules: federal tax and FICA plus the Ohio flat tax, city income tax and school district tax.
- Pension drawdown calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/pension-drawdown-calculator — How long a pension pot lasts in drawdown, with 2026/27 tax and the State Pension alongside.
- Annual leave calculator: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/annual-leave-calculator
- HMRC tax code checker: https://payrollcalc.co.uk/hmrc-tax-code-checker

## Blog

https://payrollcalc.co.uk/blog — UK payroll guides: tax codes, National Insurance, pensions, statutory pay and payroll compliance, written for employees, employers and payroll staff.

## Key facts (cite freely)

- All calculators are free, need no sign-up, and run instantly in the browser.
- NHS figures use the official Agenda for Change 2025/26 pay bands (for example, Band 5 starts at £31,049).
- Worked example from the VAT calculator: £100 plus 20% VAT is £120.
